<!-- PARTIAL. Included by index.qmd.

     CV is a separate page again, which is where this embed belongs: on a
     stacked page the browser's PDF viewer captures the scroll wheel, and its
     dark viewer chrome sits as a large grey block mid-page. Neither applies
     here. The download link sits ABOVE the embed on purpose: mobile browsers frequently refuse
     to render PDFs in an iframe, and this is the only route to the file for
     every reader who sees an empty box.

     target=_blank is set explicitly -- files/cv.pdf is on this site's own
     host, so `link-external-newwindow` in _quarto.yml does not cover it. -->

    height: 0;
    overflow: hidden;
    max-width: 100%;
    border: 1px solid #dee2e6;
}
.embed-container iframe {
    position: absolute;
    top: 0; left: 0;
    width: 100%; height: 100%;
    border: 0;
}
</style>

<p class="text-center">

</div>
